Name: Cargo Run: Engineer's Toolbox to <Alias=SecondPlanetLocation>
MissionBoardDescription: Private cargo run. Collect one toolbox from the <Alias=TargetLocation>, <Alias=TargetPlanetLocation> and deliver it to the <Alias=FinalLocation>, <Alias=SecondPlanetLocation>. Handle with care. Payment on delivery.

LogEntries.Entry: A retiring engineer at the <Alias=TargetLocation> wants her toolbox taken to the apprentice she trained, who runs his own site at the <Alias=FinalLocation> now.
The engineer is retiring and wants her toolbox to go to the apprentice she trained. She says he'll pretend he doesn't need it.
It's heavier than it looks. Every tool in it has been cleaned and oiled, and the big wrench is wrapped in a cloth on its own.
I delivered the toolbox. He opened it, found the wrench in its cloth, and didn't say anything for a while.

Objectives.DisplayText: Talk to the engineer at the <Alias=TargetLocation>
Deliver the toolbox to the engineer at the <Alias=FinalLocation>

Lines.ResponseText: You're the hauler? Good. I'm retiring, and my toolbox goes to the lad I trained. It's only one box, but it's the one that matters.
He runs his own site now, off-world. The box is by the door. Don't let him tell you he doesn't need it.
Because I'm done. Forty years of fixing other people's mistakes. My knees decided before I did.
Every tool I ever trusted. Half of them I made. The big wrench was my mother's, so tell him to mind it.
The worst. Asked why about everything. Took me a year to see that was the point.
That's her box. I'd know it anywhere. She actually sent it.
She wanted you to have it.
She told me I'd never be ready for this box. I suppose that means I am. I'll call her tonight. Thank you.
She said you'd pretend you didn't need it.
Ha. I've been borrowing a wrench off the cook for a month. Don't tell her that.
What was she like to work for?
Hard. Fair. She'd make you redo a weld three times and then buy you dinner.
To ask why. Every time. She called me the worst apprentice she ever had for it. She's the reason I know any of the answers.
